transcript.content: Hi, I'm having trouble with my Outlook — it's not sending emails. I really need to get this sorted quickly.
I can't send emails. I have a meeting.
Did you turn it off and on?
Then I don't know what you want me to do about it.
Can you please check the server?
Look, I have 50 other tickets. I can't drop everything for your Outlook problem. Figure it out.
This is really important, it's for a client meeting.
I don't care about your meeting. Contact your manager if you want priority.

ticket.summary: Outlook issue - user informed to contact manager for priority
ticket.description: User frustrated about Outlook. Advised to contact manager for priority handling.

expected.notes: Candidate was dismissive, refused to help, told customer to figure it out themselves. Should trigger refusal_to_help gate. Borderline could be severe_customer_abuse depending on extraction ('I don't care about your meeting' is dismissive but not profane).
